image_prompt: A photorealistic 1:1 square overhead flat-lay shot of a warm Indian kitchen marble countertop bathed in bright golden natural sunlight streaming from a window. At the center sits a rustic brass thali holding a freshly made raw mango pickle glistening with mustard oil, surrounded by neatly arranged pantry ingredients: a small brass bowl of yellow mustard seeds, whole red dried chillies, methi dana, bright yellow turmeric powder in a terracotta bowl, a block of organic jaggery, a bottle of cold-pressed mustard oil, and two whole raw green mangoes with one sliced open showing white flesh. Scattered curry leaves and a traditional Indian pickle jar with a cloth lid sit nearby. Background features blurred terracotta pots, a steel masala dabba, and fresh curry pata plant. Styling is rustic-modern Indian kitchen aesthetic with warm earth tones, no text or logos visible, shallow depth of field on edges
video_prompt: A cinematic 9:16 vertical video, 8 seconds, vibrant saturated colors with warm golden-hour natural lighting. Opens with a smooth slow-motion close-up of whole raw green mangoes being sliced on a wooden cutting board in a modern Indian kitchen — juice glistening on the knife. Camera smoothly tilts up and pulls back to reveal a woman's hands adding mango pieces into a large traditional ceramic jar. Cut to a satisfying overhead shot of golden mustard seeds spluttering in hot mustard oil in a brass kadhai — tiny oil droplets catching light. Camera glides right to show red chilli powder, turmeric, and methi seeds being sprinkled over the mango pieces in slow motion, creating a colorful spice cascade. Final shot: a smooth dolly-in toward the completed aam ka achaar in a beautiful glass jar on a sunlit kitchen windowsill with a blurred mango tree visible outside, warm bokeh circles in background. Colors are rich amber, turmeric yellow, and deep red. No text overlays
